name: Caveman — 65% Fewer Output Tokens
hook: "Why use many token when few token do trick." Julius Brussee's Claude Code skill strips articles, filler words, and pleasantries from Claude's responses while leaving generated code intact — averaging 65% fewer output tokens (range 22–87%) with claimed 100% technical accuracy retention. 67.8k stars, 14 releases, and one-line install across Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and 30+ agents.

name: Claude Code v2.1.160 — `ultracode` Replaces `workflow`
hook: Released June 2: the dynamic-workflow trigger keyword is renamed from `workflow` to `ultracode` — any script pattern-matching on the literal word 'workflow' must update now. Security hardening adds confirmation prompts before Claude writes to shell startup files (.zshenv, .zlogin, .bash_login) or build-tool configs (.npmrc, .yarnrc, bunfig.toml, .bazelrc); WSL clipboard copy-on-select fixed; background sessions no longer lose chat history on resume.

name: Anthropic Files S-1 — Then Claude Goes Down
hook: Anthropic confidentially filed its S-1 with the SEC on June 1, reporting $47B annualized revenue and a $965B valuation — then Claude went down globally on June 2 from ~0600–1042 UTC. Root cause: a malfunction in Claude Code's sub-agent system caused agents to multiply in a loop, driving unexpected token consumption spikes. Quotas were reset for all affected users.

name: Project Glasswing Expands to 200 Partners + Mythos Coming Public
hook: Anthropic announced June 2 that Project Glasswing — its Mythos-powered codebase security program — expands from ~50 to ~200 partner organizations spanning 15+ countries, adding energy, water, healthcare, and comms sectors. Partners have found 10,000+ high/critical severity flaws to date. Anthropic also promised Mythos-class models will ship to all customers "in the coming weeks."
recurring_note: ↑ Follow-on — anthropic-series-h-mythos (May 31) covered the $965B raise; today Glasswing quadruples and Mythos goes general soon

name: oh-my-openagent — 8-Agent Team Mode for Complex Codebases
hook: v4.6.0 (June 1) of the TypeScript agent harness runs up to 8 parallel sub-agents — Sisyphus orchestrates, Hephaestus digs deep, Prometheus plans, Oracle advises, Librarian retrieves — with LSP integration, AST-Grep for pattern-aware search, hash-anchored edits (Hashline), and built-in MCPs for web search and GitHub code search. 60.7k stars; multi-harness refactor in progress for OpenCode, Codex, and Pi.

name: baoyu-skills — 20+ Daily-Work Image & Diagram Skills
hook: Jim Liu's curated skill collection for daily work just dropped v2.4.0 (May 30): image card generation in XHS/Instagram style, SVG diagrams, Markdown-to-HTML, infographics, comics, and Midjourney prompt generation. v2.4.0 adds MiniMax, Jimeng, and Seedream image providers plus custom sizing and reference-image support. 20.2k stars; install only the skills you need — bulk-loading all adds unnecessary context on every run.

name: claude-code-ultimate-guide — 181 Templates + Security Hooks
hook: Florian Bruniaux's exhaustive reference ships 24,000+ lines across 10 sections, 181 production-ready templates (agents, skills, hooks), 37 security hooks in Bash and PowerShell, a 655-pattern malicious-skill catalogue, 271 knowledge-quiz questions, and an embedded MCP server with 17 specialized tools. Last updated May 27, 4.6k stars. Unique emphasis on trade-off analysis and *why* patterns work.
